direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; side zone condensed without scrolling; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings, rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary; emerald #A8F04A sole accent, #050705 on primary, one primary per viewport; stopped uses silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; animated flow only along feasible emerald routes; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG dominant; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence under separate headings, status and controls; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; action bar Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG refit to fill at least 70% of main: depth shadows, state glow, emerald flow on feasible routes only, silver idle machines, CELL-MILL-2 stopped in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE; MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70, aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text
